features.name: Validator check C16 — feature-list lifecycle invariant plus schema doc-truth fix
features.description: Mechanize the feature-lifecycle invariant as validator check C16 (feature lists validate against their schema; every complete feature that declares a contract also carries a QA verdict and on-disk evidence), wire it into default, payload-skip, and --target modes with positive and negative fixtures, and correct the false enforcement claim in schema/README.md.
acceptance_tests: bash tools/validate.sh --payload 2>&1 | grep -E '^SUMMARY \(payload mode\): 12 passed, 0 failed$'

features.name: standard/definition_of_done.md — the canonical layered standard plus registration
features.description: Author the canonical Definition of Done document that aggregates the eight done-layers by citing their existing authorities rather than restating them, classifies enforcement honestly, defines complete over the existing feature-list enum with no done state, and register it in NIZAM.json, standard/README.md, and the user guide.
acceptance_tests: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('NIZAM.json')); assert any(c['id']=='nizam-definition-of-done' for c in d['capabilities']); assert 'standard/definition_of_done.md' in next(m for m in d['modules'] if m['path']=='standard')['key_documents']"

features.name: Optional advisory dod_ref key on five schemas
features.description: Add an identically worded optional dod_ref string property to the contract, qa_verdict (both anyOf branches), feature_list, work-packet, and engineering_finding schemas, leaving every required array unchanged so the change is a loosening, and prove the loosening with a positive fixture.
acceptance_tests: python3 -c "import glob,re; bad=[p for p in glob.glob('schema/*.schema.json') for r in re.findall(r'\"required\"\\s*:\\s*\\[[^]]*\\]', open(p).read()) if 'dod_ref' in r]; assert not bad, bad"

features.name: templates/DoD.md — the copy-and-fill consumer template
features.description: Ship a governed, frontmattered consumer template that projects the canonical standard into a fillable per-project checklist with one block per layer, a project-specific criteria block, a floor-not-guarantee note, and a dod_ref pointer, registered in NIZAM.json and templates/README.md.
acceptance_tests: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('NIZAM.json')); assert 'templates/DoD.md' in next(m for m in d['modules'] if m['path']=='templates')['key_documents']; assert 'templates/DoD.md' in d['templates']"

features.name: .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md — the merge-layer projection
features.description: Add a plain-markdown pull-request checklist that names standard/definition_of_done.md as the canonical source and projects its merge layer into at least eight actionable boxes covering validation, self-test, e2e, version/change_log pairing, the C16 chain, evidence, changelog, close-out, and no self-merge or self-tag.

features.name: Release close-out gate — internal version-consistency mechanization
features.description: Add a stdlib-only close-out script under .github/scripts with pull-request and tag modes asserting that every version anchor, README pin, changelog heading, and roadmap release line agrees with NIZAM.json framework.version, wire it as a paths-filtered pull-request workflow and as a blocking pre-publish step in release.yml, and keep it incapable of creating or pushing refs.
acceptance_tests: python3 -c "import re,sys; s=open('.github/workflows/release_closeout.yml').read(); assert all(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', u.split('@')[1].split()[0]) for u in re.findall(r'uses:\\s*\\S+', s)), 'unpinned action'"
python3 -c "s=open('.github/workflows/release.yml').read(); assert s.index('release_closeout.py') < s.index('Create or update the GitHub Release'), 'close-out must run before publish'"

features.name: v1.1.0 release preparation and phase close
features.description: Bump every version anchor to 1.1.0 in C10 lockstep, cut the dated MINOR changelog section with its release-tier banner, write the readiness record and its replayable verification script, and close the phase across the canonical phase document, manifest, roadmap, gates register, debt register, and derived run state without creating a tag.
acceptance_tests: python3 -c "import json; f=json.load(open('.agent/feature_list_013.json'))['features']; assert all(x['status']=='complete' for x in f), [x['id'] for x in f if x['status']!='complete']"
